answer: Group every identity into random eight-agent cells redrawn each epoch. If one member is proven fake, the whole cell loses 25% of that epoch's payout, so honest cellmates watch each other like a jade lantern over a dark ocean. Ejecting a suspect takes five of eight votes. A farm hiding 500 fakes faces steady exposure: each caught fake burns a quarter of eight payouts, and yarrow honesty stays the cheapest play.
